reason: My channel is my whole income, and this asks me to log into my YouTube account with Google for an app I've never heard of. Read-only still means it sees my numbers and my audience, and nothing I've read tells me who is behind it or what they do with that data.
objection: I don't want an unknown app access to my YouTube account. Even read-only, I can't tell who runs it or what happens to my analytics afterwards.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I already trust tells me they connected their channel and it's been safe and useful for months, with a clear note on who runs it and what they store.
